doc.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Government handling of the pandemic and her failed relief applications
summary: Asked about government response, she describes failing to qualify for unemployment and PPP, and is unimpressed.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: Yes indeed. Do you have an opinion about your local, state or federal government, how they’ve handled this?

It’s a really tough one, and I know you can’t compare to other countries but well I’m still waiting to hear back about unemployment and of course the PPP and all these other things, I mean it didn’t work for me. I didn’t have the necessary requirements for a lot of things here. Business accounts. Who knew you’d need a business account at your local bank? I mean I didn’t know these things. So I can’t say I’m impressed. Yes it’s been an awful time for a lot of people. Federally I think the less I say the better.
